title: Malus Intercursus
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Malus Intercursus", at revision 1355628684, opens: "The Malus Intercursus was a commercial treaty signed in April 1506 by King Henry VII of England and Duke Philip IV of Burgundy. The treaty was signed while Philip was stranded in England, after surviving a shipwreck." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q60740017, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1506 commercial treaty between England and Burgandy". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
